description: Documentation and tutorial content for using SQLite 3 with Flask, including code examples, explanations of database connection management, query functions, and schema initialization.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Function to get or create a SQLite database connection within Flask's application context.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Teardown function to close the database connection at the end of the app context.

methods.name: query_db
methods.description: Function to execute a SQL query and fetch results, optionally returning a single record.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Function to initialize the database schema from an external SQL file.
